"first input position is valid for a match even during first usage of context by starting reference at 1 (avoiding the problematic 0)" — likely in ZSTD_loadDictionaryContent or ZSTD_compressBegin... Actually zstd has in ZSTD_compress_insertDictionary: `if (dictID) ...` Hmm. Known zstd commit: "fix #1241: ensure first position is valid ... starting reference at 1" — I recall in ZSTD_compressBegin_internal / ZSTD_resetCCtx... Actually likely `ZSTD_compressBlock_fast` ip=... Better: search lib/compress/zstd_compress.c for "dictEnd" or "prefixStart". The known fix: in ZSTD_loadDictionaryContent, `ZSTD_invalidateMatchState`? The problematic 0: `ms->window.dictLimit`? I think it's `ZSTD_window_init`: originally set `base = srcStart - ip[?]`... Actually known zstd commit 59d70f4 "fix #1241" sets in ZSTD_window_init: `ZSTD_window_clear(zs); zs->base = zs->dictBase = srcStart - start;`? Let me just search.
